WorkerIdentity.worker_id: nonempty string, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes
WorkerIdentity.implementation_diff_sha256: reviewed diff digest; empty diff digest for B0

types.CallToken: worker-local increasing positive integer; never a packet or permission identity
types.SpanToken: reserved slot integer; unique per worker, no reuse

PrepOutcome.existing_status: original scalar diagnostic status or null

FrozenSidecar.spans: bounded span_fields rows with integer or null endpoints and missing reasons
FrozenSidecar.physical_outcomes: post-run observed completion/accepted/application timestamps or null with reasons; application_permission_status remains not_implemented_or_unobserved
FrozenSidecar.clock_publication_tail: unmeasured after last endpoint; no invented bound
FrozenSidecar.export_scope: scalar timing/identity/outcome evidence; no state/control/slack/gain arrays

ExportReport.sha256: string or null; no digest of incomplete file presented as complete

types.RecorderLimits: Frozen integer limits exactly named in limits_proposed_for_review; validate before recording; no numerical objects.

ClockAllowance.provenance: approved calibration/review identity; absent means uncalibrated

ReconciliationReport.call_reports: bounded scalar inclusive/exclusive/residual records by clock; null where partial

signatures.name: create_recorder
signatures.signature: create_recorder(*, mode: str, identity: WorkerIdentity, limits: RecorderLimits, clock: ClockReader | None = None) -> Recorder | None
signatures.contract: off returns None without constructing buffers or reading clocks. profile1-v1 constructs bounded scalar-only recorder. Other mode rejected before numerical imports. ClockReader injection only in approved integrity tests.

signatures.name: Recorder.begin_call
signatures.signature: begin_call(self, *, kind: str, plan_id: int | None, release_sim_s: float | None, estimate_sim_s: float | None) -> CallToken | None
signatures.contract: Construction and clock_probe have null plan/simulated fields; startup plan 0; recurring plan >=1. One active call per worker. Initial dispatch clock pair precedes slot/metadata work. Capture inputs available at release only.

signatures.name: Recorder.active_call
signatures.contract: Read-only property returning the current token; no global/thread-local registry. Internal recorder is single-writer and detects another writer thread.

signatures.name: Recorder.span_begin
signatures.signature: span_begin(self, call: CallToken, span_id: str, *, expected_parent: str | None) -> SpanToken | None
signatures.contract: Validate span catalog and actual stack parent; reserve one slot for both endpoints, number occurrence by (call,span_id,parent_token) from 1, then wall/CPU pair. None means sticky observer fault; original numerical code still executes unchanged.

signatures.name: Recorder.span_end
signatures.signature: span_end(self, token: SpanToken | None, *, exit: str, exception_type: str | None = None) -> str
signatures.contract: Wall then CPU pair, fill the reserved slot and pop exactly that top token. Complete marks lexical completion, not numerical success. Catch ordinary observer errors internally; never raise them into planner/solver exception handlers.

signatures.name: Recorder.finish_call
signatures.signature: finish_call(self, call: CallToken | None, *, outcome: PrepOutcome) -> str
signatures.contract: Retain original preparation outcome, finish sidecar append work, then wall/CPU dispatch endpoint. Unclosed spans become partial/invalid, never successful zero spans. End-stamp publication/return tail is outside the last endpoint and explicitly unmeasured, with independent observer assessment.

signatures.name: Recorder.stop_requested
signatures.contract: Read-only sticky fault flag; checked only at named existing safe reporting boundaries, never used as a numerical fallback or authority grant.

signatures.name: Recorder.reconcile
signatures.signature: reconcile(self, *, clock_allowance_ns: ClockAllowance | None = None) -> ReconciliationReport
signatures.contract: Post-kernel integer arithmetic only: inclusive duration and subtraction of immediate complete disjoint children. Partial coverage yields unknown exclusive values/reasons. Preserve signed residual and clock-skew evidence; never clamp. Cache the report for seal; missing reviewed allowance is explicitly unresolved, not zero.

signatures.name: Recorder.seal
signatures.signature: seal(self, *, legacy_result: Mapping[str, object] | None, termination: str) -> FrozenSidecar
signatures.contract: After the measured worker, join already observed legacy completion/handoff/application outcomes; no clock reads, new solves, warm-state copies or future inputs. Seal once, record open calls/spans as partial, and reject subsequent recording. Require a prior reconciliation report; unresolved allowance remains visible, never promoted to approved.

signatures.name: write_sidecar
signatures.contract: Post-measurement serialization only, in a fresh exclusively owned worker directory. Create .partial exclusively; flush and fsync before publishing a fresh final filename. Never overwrite. Keep partial data on failure and report it; original numerical result is written/preserved separately first.

import_and_injection.launcher: Parse --efficiency-instrumentation {off,profile1-v1}, default off, with stdlib only. Reject unsupported values before imports/configuration of any numerical backend. In off mode do not import recorder.py at all.
import_and_injection.ON_order: Fresh child: configure supported native SINGLE before numerical imports; import recorder module only for explicit ON; create identity/limits; inject same recorder into composition, planner and AsyncRunner. Numerical objects never import the research recorder module; optional recorder=None arguments only.
import_and_injection.OFF_path: No newly added clock reads, capture containers, spans, lambdas, context managers, payload dictionaries or tuple snapshots. Branch on recorder is not None around all new observation. Existing numerical/legacy diagnostic allocations remain. No claim of zero disabled-branch CPU cost; B0/B1 assesses it.
import_and_injection.no_runtime_framework: Stdlib bounded slots and explicit try/finally hooks; no global patching, sys.settrace, contextvars framework, solver replacement or dependency changes.
import_and_injection.supported_recorder: Only create_recorder output at the reviewed API version is supported; validate at research composition before backend construction. Arbitrary third-party recorder objects require review.

limits_proposed_for_review.storage: One slot per begun span holds both endpoints; a first-fault/emergency status slot is reserved at creation. No dropping, ring overwrite or retaining numerical arrays. Limits are software/output caps, not a proof of total Python RSS; G2 has its own RSS guard.
limits_proposed_for_review.fault_after_limit: Latch first failure, stop recording new spans/calls without interrupting original active numerical computation, close already reserved endpoints if possible, then stop at the reporting boundary. Never begin a new preparation after fault.

identity_and_clock_rules.ordering: For every pair, wall first then process CPU, raw integers. Verify nondecreasing endpoints per clock. Record actual clock implementations/resolution outside kernels in G2. Host time, process CPU and simulated seconds remain separate.
identity_and_clock_rules.reentrancy: No second call while one active; no implicit parent repair; out-of-order/missing tokens or foreign worker/thread mark invalid. No lock contention or cross-worker global state introduced.
identity_and_clock_rules.exception_detail: Qualified exception type only inside hooks; never call arbitrary exception __str__/repr or traceback formatter there. Original diagnostics are untouched. Larger error text, if safe, belongs to post-kernel worker report.
identity_and_clock_rules.missing: not_reached, partial, unavailable and aborted are distinct. Only a sampled complete zero interval is zero. Null needs a reason.
identity_and_clock_rules.integer_range: Raw endpoint is a non-boolean nonnegative signed-64-bit integer nanosecond count or null with reason; reject anomalous injected types/ranges without exposing errors to numerical handlers.

span_tree_policy: The 22 IDs and their parent graph are copied exactly from accepted Phase A; no extra recurring spans or per-Jacobian microspans. Repeated preview geometry/reference occurrences have separate ordinals. Dispatch and one-time construction are separate populations.

construction_tree.scope: Research launcher before fixture loading through completed controller/planner/plant/tracker; excludes recorder creation, which is reported separately in whole-worker startup.

Existing IpoptSolver constructor from make_mpc caller; construction_seconds preserved.
Existing MPCController constructor from make_mpc caller.

legacy_boundaries.planner_total_time: Original perf_counter start planner.py:31 to sample at :84. New timing overhead inside that interval remains naturally included; name/start/end not moved.
legacy_boundaries.planner_cpu_time: Original process_time at planner.py:31 to :85; preserve process CPU meaning.
legacy_boundaries.solve_time: Success: original IpoptSolver.solve start :34 to :44; RuntimeError: original :34 to :74. Backend-only span is not a renamed solve_time.
legacy_boundaries.packet_metadata: Original solve_duration and total_computation_duration values continue to originate from the same legacy fields. Do not replace with new full/envelope timers.
legacy_boundaries.startup: Startup prepare is measured separately and is gated at simulated completion 0 as before. Construction/startup are not recurring CPU/simulated-s.

readiness.legacy: AsyncRunner.run.release continues original c.delay(plan_id,event[planner_total_time]) or existing DiagnosticTiming path, unchanged.
readiness.full: prepare_full pair starts at research caller immediately before prepare invocation, ends after receipt of exactly the original tuple or escaped exception. Final packet replacement and return assembly included.
readiness.dispatch: begin_call immediately before asynchronous.py:222 capture/prefix block, after original estimate-at-release calculation; finish_call after prepare/sidecar append and before :246 delay selection. Release prologue :212-221 is outside this explicitly named envelope.
readiness.overhead: Independent paired B0/B1 and B1/B2 differences plus clock-operation counts and calibration. Exclusive residual contains numerical bookkeeping AND instrumentation; never label all residual as observer cost or subtract a presumed constant.
readiness.publication_tail: Last endpoint-field publication/return cannot be enclosed in its own clock pair. Mark it unmeasured and assess independently; no universal zero-cost claim or invented bound.
readiness.hypothetical: Post-measurement only: release_sim_s + full_prepare_wall_ns/1e9 and release_sim_s + dispatch_wall_ns/1e9, with differences from the ORIGINAL modeled legacy completion clearly labelled hypothetical_measured. Under injected/spike timing these are counterfactual host-duration mappings, not replacement replay outcomes.
readiness.authority: No hypothetical field enters estimator, packet, pending queue, deadline comparison, buffer, tracker, accepted timestamp or application permission. Phase B full-boundary policy remains separate review.

capture_prohibition: G1 introduces scalar timing/identity/outcome sidecars only. No dense numerical snapshot recorder, new warm-start history capture, historical reconstruction or context-panel generation. G2 test-only in-memory observation is separately authorized and never substitutes for Phase B history.

clock_probe_catalog.rule: G2 clock-only calibration population: one call, 1000 disjoint empty single spans plus 1000 empty parent/child pairs. Not preparation, construction or simulated work; no extra recurring span IDs.

physical_outcome_join: Only raw.plans[i].completed == true establishes observed completion; completion_time and packet.actual_completion_time may already contain scheduled future times on an incomplete call, so retain those as scheduled and set observed completion null/censored. Accepted time requires an accepted handoff record, and application time requires an observed applied control row. Never infer Safety permission or an acknowledgement.
